aboutUs.title: Who We Are
aboutUs.summary: Extreme Fitness Studio is committed to providing a welcoming and results-driven environment for individuals of all fitness levels. Our mission is to empower members to reach their goals through expert guidance, diverse training programs, and a strong sense of community. Whether you're starting your fitness journey or looking to push past a plateau, we’re here to support and challenge you every step of the way.

list.name: Jaxon Ramirez
list.greeting: You won’t find shortcuts here—just intensity, sweat, and results. Show up, work hard, and I’ll make sure you leave stronger than you came in.

list.name: Leah Chen
list.greeting: Balance, breath, and strength—my sessions help you reconnect with your body and discover the power that comes from slowing things down with purpose.

list.name: Marcus Oduro
list.greeting: We build strength from the ground up. With the right mindset and technique, you'll lift heavier and feel more powerful than ever before.

list.name: Sophie Bennett
list.greeting: Endurance is earned, not given. Every ride is a challenge, but I’ll keep you motivated and moving until you crush every goal you set.

list.name: Darius Lee
list.greeting: A strong core isn’t just about abs—it’s your foundation. Let’s train smart, move better, and build real strength that lasts beyond the gym.

list.name: Amira Khalil
list.greeting: Recovery isn’t optional—it’s essential. I’ll help you reset, realign, and stay injury-free so you can train consistently and perform your best.

list.name: Mike Tyler
list.greeting: I turn your data into progress. Whether it’s wearables or metrics, I’ll guide you with smart insights to train efficiently and push your limits.
